name: Native Root Paths
description: Probes filesystem paths associated with KernelSU, APatch, and Magisk using multi-confirmation (stat/lstat/open) to detect root management artifacts.

evidenceUnits.title: Native root-framework path artifact
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Filesystem paths associated with KernelSU, APatch, or Magisk
evidenceUnits.proposition: A maintained framework path was confirmed by the recorded native path operations
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: Native stat, lstat, and open confirmations
evidenceUnits.availability: Depends on path visibility, permissions, and process mount namespace
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The app-local VFS can be filtered by concealment or kernel changes
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A path artifact does not prove that the associated provider is active for this process
